en: A hand-colored postcard depicting a historic European spa town with elegant turn-of-the-century architecture nestled at the edge of a forest. The buildings are multi-story with ornate facades, many with balconies and red or grey roofs. One building has the word 'BUDAPEŠT' visible. Trees and greenery surround the town, and the foreground shows a street with a few pedestrians and an old automobile.
